create.authentication: Opaque admin session; audit:read; actor/session/role version rechecked inside transaction
create.idempotency: Non-nil UUID Idempotency-Key; same requester/session/roleVersion/filter digest returns original live artifact; changed input conflicts
create.overLimit: INVALID_REQUEST; narrowDateRange field; no partial or silently truncated export

access: Metadata and content require same staff, exact originating session and current roleVersion; no bearer artifact URL. Cross-requester/session returns NOT_FOUND. Expired artifacts return IDEMPOTENCY_RECEIPT_EXPIRED. Artifact lifetime is 15 minutes.
privacy: Same explicit action-specific safe projection as GET audit; unknown before/after and event reasons remain null.
Support-only role is restricted to own ADMIN_STAFF rows by SQL.
No joins to user PII or financial tables.
Result encrypted with existing AEAD and immutable export/staff/session/roleVersion AAD; digest and bytes verified on download.
Creation and authorized download each append audit in the same transaction before response.
No-store and nosniff on responses; JSON avoids spreadsheet formula evaluation.
retention: Existing authentication maintenance clears at most 100 expired encrypted bodies per iteration with row locks; opId, digest and metadata remain to reject expired replays. No live artifact is cleared.
remaining: Combined production asset and browser acceptance
Real PostgreSQL role, idempotency, isolation, expiry cleanup and audit rollback acceptance
